findings: Revenue declined 2.3% year over year ($231,139 in 2023 vs $225,731 in 2024) - growth is flat, so new demand levers are needed.
Q4 (Oct-Dec) alone brings 31.3% of annual revenue (25% would be an even split) - stock and campaigns should peak before October.
Home & Kitchen is the strongest category (32.3% of revenue); Books is the smallest (4.7%).
South leads the regions while Central is the weakest - a clear target for regional campaigns.
Delivery speed drives satisfaction: orders delivered in 3 days or less average a 4.61 rating vs 3.78 for 7+ days (correlation -0.48).
UPI is the most used payment method (30.5% of orders).
Discounted orders average $106 vs $117 at full price: discounts do not lift basket size, so their profitability should be tested.
'Smartwatch' is the best-selling product by revenue ($66,571).
